meta.purpose: Backtest set: 2026 World Cup matches played 11-14 June 2026, used to score the model at match level.
meta.sourcing: Results corroborated across multiple outlets (ESPN/NBC/Fox/RotoWire/Olympics) via web search; see PR description. June 11-13 are well-corroborated (verified=true); June 14 reported by single outlets (verified=false). WebFetch was blocked, so treat as best-effort, not official.
meta.odds: Pre-match decimal 1X2 where retrievable; only Mexico-South Africa had a usable sharp-ish line. null elsewhere.
meta.outcome_codes: home/draw/away relative to the listed home team (venues are neutral; 'home' is just the first-listed team).
